text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I are training outside,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... You're Т.М. Опера О, aren't
you? I'm
a huge fan!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Well, now! You must have an eye for
aesthetics!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I shall reward it with a special copy of
my new
headshot I took just yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Not a single one! Where could they have
all
gone?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Didn't you just pass out a big stack of them?

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, what have I done?! That was the
entire
stock?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry. Please, would you
accept my
autograph for now?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The fan looks overjoyed to get an
autograph, but
Opera O is in utter
despair.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
